sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 462 x 363 x 527 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Genelec 7360A product page and manual pages 2 and 3 (read by a research pass 2026-11-12): seven XLR female analog inputs (7.1) and seven XLR male analog outputs, an LFE XLR input and an LFE XLR output, an XLR female AES/EBU input and an XLR male AES/EBU output (thru), a Link in and out of an unstated type, two RJ45 GLM ports, a bypass contact, and a rear MAINS INPUT 100-240 V, 300 W (the inlet type is not named: iec-c14 follows the 8341A precedent, listed in the plan as assumedConnectors). Modelled subset: 2 analog in and out, LFE in and out, AES in and out, 2 GLM ports, the inlet. The panel layout and the driver layout are not stated: the cabinet is a plain rounded box with no drivers drawn (nothing in the page read gives the baffle). 462 x 363 x 527 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
